subject.title: fix(commands): re-check owner for cross-channel /allowlist writes

question: Should configured `commands.ownerAllowFrom` identities, wildcard configured owners, and gateway admins retain global cross-channel `/allowlist` write authority while channel fallback and context-derived owners require target ownership?
rationale: The implementation consistently enforces this split, but it defines a privileged cross-channel configuration contract that should not be finalized without human security ownership.

options.title: Approve split authority
options.body: Retain global authority for configured owners, wildcard configured owners, and gateway admins while target-checking channel and context-derived owners.

options.title: Require broader target ownership
options.body: Require target ownership for configured identities as well, with compatibility analysis and updated regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Approve split authority
recommendation.body: Retain global authority for configured owners, wildcard configured owners, and gateway admins while target-checking channel and context-derived owners.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person most strongly to the shared config-write security policy and the central authorization files.
